name: gizza-ai/image-info
summary: Report an image's format, dimensions, and color type.

tool.description: Report an image's properties without uploading it: format (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP/TIFF/ICO), pixel dimensions, megapixels, aspect ratio, color type (RGB/RGBA/grayscale and bit depth), channel count, bits per pixel, whether it has an alpha channel, and the file size in bytes. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
